## Rust — dash-sdk, rs-dapi-client, dpp, platform-wallet, rs-platform-wallet-ffi

| Keyword | Pkg | Δ | Change | Migration | Ref |
|---------|-----|---|--------|-----------|-----|
| `UtxoRestoreEntryFFI` | rs-platform-wallet-ffi | ± | **Breaking ABI**. Adds `parent_context` and `parent_block_height` (`u32` each), increasing the 64-bit size from 152 to 160 bytes. | Rebuild C consumers against the matching header. Populate both fields from the stored creating transaction, using zero when unavailable. | [C:c2787e4072] |
| `asset_lock_manager_resume`, `asset_lock_manager_catch_up_blocking` | rs-platform-wallet-ffi | ± | Blocking resume paths use a dedicated larger-stack worker. | Keep invoking blocking paths off the UI thread. | [C:f00eceb0bb] |
| `StoredParentState`, `reconcile_with_parent` | platform-wallet | + | Parent transaction finality can raise a restored coin to confirmed or InstantSend-locked. | Use `wallet::core::stored_coin` when reconciling custom restore data. | [C:c2787e4072] |
| `held_output_details` | platform-wallet | + | Looks for a known or held output by outpoint during restoration. | Use the helper when implementing custom restore logic. | [C:0f6e0d7191] |
| `is_allowed_identity_create_denomination` | dpp | + | Public predicate for the identity-create asset-lock denomination. | Use it to validate candidate funding outputs for the target protocol. | [PR:5731] |
| `NetworkShieldedCoordinator::sync` | platform-wallet | ± | Concurrent wallet sync no longer records duplicate note commitments. | Upgrade for consistent balances after overlapping sync calls. | [C:2ccf07e362] |
| `sync_address_balances` | dash-sdk | ± | Fetches the compacted range when the recent address balance proof has no boundary. | Upgrade to recover balances represented only by compacted changes. | [C:b4f76d5169] |
| `WasmClient` | rs-dapi-client | ± | WASM transport correctly sends a single-slash request path. | Existing callers can keep the same request construction. | [C:227e6a4f5c] |
